personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: An Inbox that never lies about being empty is what I open first every morning.

objection.text: A staggered shimmer on every list is the kind of motion that hides a slow page instead of fixing it; I want proof it never shifts the layout when the data arrives.

rounds.fit: Fits every persona once the layout is proven not to shift.
